description: Amending the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act, No.11 of 1984
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act, No.11 of 1984, has made provisions for the establishment of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board, the determination of the powers of the Board and matters incidental thereto. With the increasing cases of drug trafficking and abuse, there is a pressing need to amend the said Act to expand the functions and powers of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board. Accordingly, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs, it was decided to grant policy approval of the Cabinet to amend the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act, No.11 of 1984 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill incorporating the proposed amendments.
